h: Repairing Speech Hearing and Sight Through the Three Haftaros

p: וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג רכט, ב)
And in the holy Zohar (this parshah, III 229b):
"And in sight, hearing, smell, and speech
in action, in touch, use, and walking,
from the side of the right, of Avraham,
where there is the sight of Torah:
מִימִינוֹ אֵשׁ דָּת לָמוֹ (דְּבָרִים לג, ב)
'From His right hand, a fiery law for them'" (Devarim 33:2).
"'Let there be light': this is Avraham";
And this is why it says
"from the side of the right, of Avraham,
where there is the sight of Torah";
וְזֶה שֶׁמֵּבִיא הַפָּסוּק אֵשׁ דָּת לָמוֹ
and this is why it brings the pasuk "a fiery law for them,"
וְזֶה מְרוּמָּז בְּאוֹת י׳ מִשֵּׁם הֲוָיָ״ה
And this is alluded to in the letter yud of the Name Havayah,
וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (תְּרוּמָה, חֵלֶק ב קעה, ב)
and in the holy Zohar (Terumah, II 175b):
וְחֶסֶד בְּחִינַת אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and Chessed is the aspect of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him.
'Hashem, I have heard Your report and I was afraid.'"
the attribute of the Fear of Yitzchak,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת בְּשַׁלַּח)
as is written in the holy Zohar (beginning of parshas Beshalach).
וְעַל זֶה מְרַמֵּז הַה׳ הָרִאשׁוֹנָה שֶׁבַּשֵּׁם
And to this alludes the first hei of the Name,
which is the aspect of Binah;
and Gevurah, which is severe judgment,
as is written in the holy Zohar (Terumah, Zohar II 175b);
וְכֵן כָּתַב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב יד, ב)
and so it writes in the holy Zohar (II 14b):
"He made Avraham in the secret of Chochmah,
Yitzchak in the secret of Tevunah."
where there is 'a pleasing aroma to Hashem,' etc."
That is, according to what is said,
וְעַל זֶה מְרַמֵּז אוֹת ו׳ מֵהַשֵּׁם
and to this alludes the letter vav of the Name,
for the letter vav is called "the letter of truth"
And it says "where there is a pleasing aroma":
because of Yaakov it is written (Bereishis 27:27):
"And he smelled the aroma of his garments,
and said: See, the aroma of my son
is like the aroma of a field that Hashem has blessed."
the fourth support, of Adam HaRishon,
who was joined with the Avos."
Speech is the attribute of Malchus,
וְעַל זֶה מְרַמֵּז ה׳ אַחֲרוֹנָה דְּהַשֵּׁם
and to this alludes the last hei of the Name;
which we call Torah she'b'al peh."
"'The word of Hashem': this is halachah,"
which is "My words which I have put in your mouth."
And this is the fourth support;
for in truth David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
is a chariot for the attribute of Malchus,
and he is the fourth leg of the Chariot:
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קנד, ב; רמח, ב)
And they correspond to the four directions:
the aspect of Avraham and Yitzchak;
Only that then, in the days of Moshe Rabbeinu,
David was not yet in the world,
who was the soul of David, as is known:
And in the Midrash (Vayikra Rabbah 14:1, beginning of Tazria):
זֶה רוּחוֹ שֶׁל מֶלֶךְ הַמָּשִׁיחַ וְכוּלֵּי
is the spirit of King Mashiach, etc."
And Adam joined with the Avos
and he was a chariot for the attribute of Malchus.
And this is what is stated further on in the holy Zohar:
like a person who is happy with his lot,
and not like the Erev Rav, etc.,
like the serpent, before whom is the whole earth;
'And dust shall be the serpent's food';
and he is afraid to eat his fill of dust,
for he fears it will run out."
And before the corruption of the serpent,
And this is speech, opposite the serpent,
which is speech in the kelipah,
which is called "a man of tongue,"
וְעַיֵּין בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קנב, א)
"Kuf does not stay settled in its place,
'A man of tongue shall not be established in the land'";
And this is according to what is written
that goes after a person, etc.";
goes after the woman of valor, etc.";
and it is opposite the last hei.
"Who is the man who desires life,
who loves days, to see good?"
that is, the attribute of the tzaddik,
"Say of the tzaddik that it is good";
and they said that the covenant of the tongue
corresponds to the covenant of the flesh.
And afterward the holy Zohar says:
וְנֶשֶׁר כְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and eagle corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
who is called the merciful one among the Avos
And the powers of sight, hearing, and smell
and this is why it is stated in the holy Zohar,
are to rectify what they blemished
which correspond to the lower hei,
the upper hei, and the yud.
"And he smelled the aroma of his garments";
and it is stated (Bereishis Rabbah, end of parshah 65):
which expounds "the aroma of his garments"
and Yaakov, whose offspring was complete,
will in the future give off a good aroma,
and "the lip of truth shall be established forever,"
and they did not spoil smell at all;
automatically the aspect of smell too
which are "a pleasing aroma to Hashem,"
and this we do not have in exile.
which is the power of the serpent,
which are the blemish of the serpent;
and we rectify the attribute of good,
and we merit "dwell in the land,"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, רכה, ב)
(as is written in the holy Zohar on this parshah, III 225b);
and we rectify what they blemished in speech,
And afterward we rectify hearing and sight,
And the time to rectify is on Shabbos,
shin is the secret of the three Avos,
and the bas is crowned with them
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
of the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah,
the Name Havayah and the Name Adnus;
what they blemished in the powers
that are reckoned opposite the Name Adnus
in the holy Zohar, as mentioned above.
